name: Mortal Kombat II — Liu Kang Ending
notes: Primary arcade-ending text preserved by Mortal Kombat Warehouse, used as preservation/access infrastructure rather than canonical authority. Liu Kang's ending explicitly describes his Outworld run continuing until Shao Kahn is defeated. This is direct ending-level candidate evidence for exact victor attribution, but it is not promoted to a canon individual-victor Fact without later non-ending Original-continuity confirmation.
